title: Justice League of America #21 DC 2018 Rebirth The Ray I Quit Steve Orlando
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Justice League of America #21 (February 2018), DC Comics - DC Universe Rebirth series. "I Quit!" - The Ray cover with Black Canary, Vixen, Killer Frost and Lobo. Written by Steve Orlando, art credited on the cover to Orlando and Byrne. $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Boomerang streaming (Scooby-Doo, Bugs Bunny, Tom and Jerry) ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
